description: MT 2025 ordinary income tax, single: taxable income $50,000 is at or above the $21,100 threshold, so the printed schedule applies 5.9% less the printed $253 constant: 2,950 - 253 = $2,697. The $253 is the exact 1.2-point figure (253.20) truncated as printed, so the schedule sits $0.20 above pure bracketing.
